ja264:1.1: The king whose name was Panāda,
ja264:1.2: had a palace (made out of) gold,
ja264:1.3: Which was sixteen lengths across, and a thousand-fold in height, they say.
ja264:2.1: A thousand sections, a hundred floors, adorned with emerald flags,
ja264:3.1: At that time this was certainly so,
ja264:3.3: At that time I was Sakka, (Lord of Devas), (now) I am your steward.
